extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: According to the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, an initial preventive physical examination (IPPE), also known as the "Welcome to Medicare" preventive visit, is a one-time introductory visit provided during the first 12 months a Medicare beneficiary has Part B benefits. The visit may include, but is not limited to, the following:

extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: A review of a beneficiary's medical and health-related social history.

extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: Education and counseling about preventive services, including certain screenings, shots and referrals for other care, if needed.

extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: Other services, such as a written plan letting the beneficiary know what preventive services the beneficiary needs. If a beneficiary has had Part B benefits for longer than 12 months, the beneficiary can receive an annual wellness visit (AWV) to develop or update a personalized prevention plan to prevent disease and disability based on the beneficiary's current health and risk factors. The following policy outlines Humana's reimbursement for claims for an IPPE and AWV.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Humana Medicare Advantage plans reimburse a charge for:

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: An IPPE service, HCPCS code G0402, once per lifetime and only if provided within the first 12 months after the effective date of the member's first Medicare Part B coverage period.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: An initial AWV service, HCPCS code G0438, once per lifetime beginning in the calendar year following the IPPE. However, the initial AWV is not dependent on reimbursement of an earlier IPPE.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: A subsequent AWV service, HCPCS code G0439, once per calendar year beginning in the calendar year following an allowed charge for HCPCS code G0438. However, a subsequent AWV is not dependent on reimbursement of an earlier AWV or IPPE. Humana limits reimbursement of HCPCS codes G0402, G0438 and G0439 to only one of these services per calendar year.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Humana Medicare Advantage plans reimburse a charge for:

An IPPE service, HCPCS code G0402, once per lifetime and only if provided within the first 12 months after the effective date of the member's first Medicare Part B coverage period.

An initial AWV service, HCPCS code G0438, once per lifetime beginning in the calendar year following the IPPE. However, the initial AWV is not dependent on reimbursement of an earlier IPPE.

A subsequent AWV service, HCPCS code G0439, once per calendar year beginning in the calendar year following an allowed charge for HCPCS code G0438. However, a subsequent AWV is not dependent on reimbursement of an earlier AWV or IPPE. Humana limits reimbursement of HCPCS codes G0402, G0438 and G0439 to only one of these services per calendar year.
